name: Noroi no Tegami
source:
The protagonist, Naoe Nagahisa, had lost his younger sister and was climbing a mountain with the intent of following her into death. At the top of the mountain, on a hill offering a panoramic view of the sea, Nagahisa meets a mysterious girl named Ichijou Hiiro.

As he became more deeply involved with Hiiro, Nagahisa eventually discovered that she was, in truth, a sorceress.

This is a short story woven from the threads of love and curses.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13500]Novelgame[/url]]
